Ka guhuren meyitenged ki

The story about

Istir

Esther

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka seini ne baseen, migpangguhud meyitenged te sabeka ne Hudiyu ne egngaranan ki Istir. Neyitabu seini dengan te timpu ne si Hari Aswiru pad ka migmandu diye te inged ne egngaranan te Pirsya. Neyimu si Istir ne rayna ni Hari Aswiru liwan ki Rayna Basti te migsupak kandin. Ne due degma sabeka ne etew ne egngaranan ki Haman ne egkeupian ne eggule te me Hudiyu, piru pinaahi te kabulut ni Istir wey te geyinawa rin te me karumaan din, nekeisip sikandin ne egpangabangan din ka me karumaan din eyew kene sikandan egpatey.

This reading, (it) stories about a Hudiyu named Istir. This happened long_ago at the time that King Aswiru still ruled in the place called Pirsiya. Istir became the queen of King Aswiru in place of Queen Basti who rebelled_against him. There was also a person named Haman who wanted to exterminate the Hudiyus, but by means of the boldness of Istir and her love for her relatives, she decided that she would save her relatives so_that they would_ not _be_killed.

Nahuhud man-e kayi ka kaligkatan te sahakeen te me Hudiyu ne egngaranan dan te Purim. Te sika ne sahakeen, egsumsumanen te me Hudiyu ke immenu sikandan te migluwas te Manama ligkat te kuntere dan ne si Haman.

Also told here is the origin of the feast of the Hudiyus that they named Purim. At that feast, the Hudiyus remember how they were_saved by God (MS Manama) from their enemy Haman.

Ka peg-apul ni Rayna Basti ki Hari Aswiru

The refusal of Queen Basti against King Aswiru

11 [xr]Dengan ne timpu, due sabeka ne Hari ne egngaranan ki Aswiru. Migmandu sikandin te 127 ne prubinsya, puun te Indiya taman te Itiyupiya. 2 Te seeye ne timpu, diye ka palasyu rin te Susa, ka iney ne siyudad.

11 [xr]Long ago, there_was a king named Aswiru. He ruled 127 provinces, from Indiya as_far_as Itiyupiya. 2 At that time, his palace was there in Susa, the mother city.

3 Te igkatelu e ne leg-un te pegmandu ni Hari Aswiru, migsahakeen sikandin para te langun ne me upisyal din wey me suluhuanen. Te seeye ne pegsahakeen, migtambung degma ka me pangulu te me sundalu diye te Pirsya wey te Midiyan, ka me talahuren, wey ka me gubirnadur te me prubinsya. 4 Seled te hen-em ne bulan ka pegsahakeen. Te seeye ne timpu, impapitew rin kamenu karakel ka karatuan din te palasyu su eyew egkakita ka kabantug din wey ka katelesan te migharian din.

3 In the third year of the reign of King Aswiru, he had_a_large_feast for all his officials and servants. At that large_feast, the leaders of the soldiers in Pirsiya and in Midiyan, the honored/respected (ones), and the governors of the provinces also attended. 4 The feasting lasted (LIT was inside of) six months. At that time, he showed how great was his wealth in the palace so_that his fame and the splendor of his kingdom would_be_seen.

5 Pegkeimpus dutu, migpasahakeen e man-e ka Hari para te langun ne matig-Susa, meyaman ma wey se egkaayu-ayu. Seled te pitu ne aldew ka seeye ne pegsahakeen wey diye himuwa te lama te palasyu te Hari ne impamulaan te me kayu wey me bulak. 6 Ne ka pinamulaan, indayan-dayanan te me maangkag wey meilem ne me kurtina ne inggiketan te me lubid ne ubi se batek ne subla ne mahal. Ne impaniyukan ka lubid te derakel ne me pelata ne sising ne insanggat diye te sungkaleg ne batu ne egngaranan te marmul. Due mallayat ne pinnuuwan ne inggimu puun te bulawan wey me pelata, wey impaneehan ka lama te me batu ne marmul, pirlas, wey te duma pad ne mahal ne me batu. 7 Ne diye ipangitis ka me inumen te nakalkalasi ne me ubab ne bulawan, wey dakel amana ka binu ne imbehey te Hari diye te me etew. 8 Ware egkatamanan te peg-iinum su insuhu ma te Hari ka me suluhuanen din ne egparumdumaan ka igkeupii te me etew.

5 After that, the king again caused_a_large_feast for all the (ones) from_Susa, the rich and the poor. That feasting lasted (LIT was_inside) seven days and was done in the courtyard of the palace of the king that was planted with trees and flowers. 6 And the garden, (it) was_decorated with white and blue/green curtains that were hung by ropes of purple/grape color and very expensive. And the rope it was threaded_through large valuable_metal rings hung from the post(s) of stone named marmul. There were long sitting_places that were_made of gold and valuable_metal, and the courtyard (it) was_floored with stones such_as marmul, pearl(s), and various very expensive stones. 7 And the drinks (they) were poured into various gold cups, and the wine that was_given by the king to the people was very great/abundant. 8 The drinking_of_wine didn't end because the king had commanded his servants to allow whatever_ the people _wanted.

9 Te seeye ne timpu, migpasahakeen degma ka asawa te Hari ne si Rayna Basti diye te palasyu para te me malitan.

9 At that time, the spouse of the king who was Queen Basti also put_on_a_feast in the palace for the women.

10 Te igkapitu e ne aldew, nahale ka Hari tenged te peg-inum-inum din. Sikan naa ka insuhu din ka pitu ne kinepun ne me suluhuanen din ne ensi Mauman, Basata, Harbuna, Bagata, Abgata, Sitar, wey si Karkas, 11 ne igpeuyan diye te tangkaan din si Rayna Basti ne egpasaluuben te kuruna. Ne iyan din tuyu su eyew egkakita te me etew wey te me upisyal ka katelesan te rayna su amana ne mateles ne egtengtengan. 12 Piru te ingkahiyan e te me suluhuanen si Rayna Basti meyitenged te suhu te Hari, mig-apul sikandin. Tenged dutu, nabelu amana ka Hari.

10 On the seventh day, the king was_happy as a result of his drinking. So then he commanded his seven castrated servants who were Mauman, Basata, Harbuna, Bagata, Abgata, Sitar, and Karkas, 11 to bring Queen Basti into his presence wearing a crown. His purpose was so_that the people and the officials could_see the splendor of the queen because (she) was very beautiful to look_at. 12 But when Queen Basti was_told by the servants about the command of the king, she refused. As a result of that, the king was_ very _angry.

13 Ne due me talagtambag te Hari ne matagseb ne me etew ne egkateu te me balaud wey me batasan dan. Seeye naa, impeumew rin sikandan sumale te nabatasan din ke due eggusayen. 14 Sikandan ensi Karsina, Sitar, Admata, Tarsis, Maris, Marsana, wey si Mamukan, ka pitu ne mabantug ne upisyal te Pirsya wey Midiyan. Sikandan degma ka labew ne me etew wey egkasalihan din. 15 Mig-insaan din sikandan, “Sumale te balaud te Pirsya, nekey ma ka eleg ne eggimuwen diye te ki Rayna Basti su ware din migpalintutuu te suhu ku pinaahi te me suluhuanen ku?”

13 And there were advisors of the king who were skillful in their laws and customs. And so, he summoned them according to his custom when there_was something to be resolved. 14 They were Karsina, Sitar, Admata, Tarsis, Maris, Marsana, Mamukan, the seven honored officials of Pirsiya and Midiyan. They were also great/prominent people and he trusted (them). 15 He asked them, “According to the law of Pirsiya, what is the correct thing to do to Queen Basti because she didn't believe/obey my command through my servants?”

16 Ne migkahi si Mamukan diye te Hari wey diye te me upisyal, “Kene ne diye de te keykew nakasale si Rayna Basti, ke kene, minsan degma kayi te kanami te me upisyal nu wey te langun ne etew diye te langun ne prubinsya ne migmanduan nu. 17 Su ka inggimu rin, egkanengnengan iya te langun ne malitan, ne puun due, egde-deehen dan e ka me iglukes dan su egkahi ma sikandan, ‘Migsuhu ka Hari ne igpeuyan diye te kandin si Rayna Basti, piru ware sikandin migpalintutuu.’ 18 Ne kuntee ne aldew, ka me malitan ne kayi te Pirsya wey diye te Midiyan ne nakarineg te inggimu te rayna, egpangguhuran dan e ka me iglukes dan meyitenged dutu. Ne puun kayi kenad egtahud ka me malitan te me asawa ran, sikan naa ka egkabbelu e degma ka me iglukes dan kandan. 19 Ke igkeupii nu, Mahal ne Hari, peuyan ka te suhu ne si Rayna Basti kenad egpakaatubang keykew. Ne igsulat naa sika ne eggimuwen ne balaud te Pirsya wey diye te Midiyan su eyew kene egkabalbalawan. Ne ka katenged te rayna, igbehey e diye te duma ne malitan ne meupiya pad kandin. 20 Sikan naa ke igpakapatahe e ka suhu diye te langun ne me prubinsya ne migmanduan nu ne subla ne maluag, egtahuren te langun ne me malitan ka me iglukes dan, meyaman ma wey se egkaayu-ayu.”

16 Then Mamukan said to the king and to the officials like this, “Queen Basti didn't just sin against you(sg), rather, even also (against) us(excl) officials and all the people in all the provinces where you(sg) rule. 17 For what she did, (it) will_ indeed _become_known by all women, and from that, they will_show_contempt_for all their male spouses because they will_say, ‘The king commanded for Queen Basti to be sent to him, but she didn't believe/obey.’ 18 And this day, the women in Pirisya and in Midiyan who heard what the queen did, they will_tell their husbands about it. And from it women will_ no_longer _respect their spouses, and so their husbands will_ also _be_angry at them. 19 If you(sg) desire, Dear King, send a command that Queen Basti can no_longer come_in_front of you(sg). And write that which will_become a law of Pirisya and Midiyan so it can't be changed. And the position/responsibility of the queen, give (it) to another woman who is better than her. 20 And_so if/when this command is made_known in all the provinces which you(sg) rule that are very vast, all the women will_respect their husbands, rich or poor.”

21 Nakapahale te Hari wey te langun ne me upisyal ka seeye ne tambag, wey intuman din ka langun ne ingkahi ni Mamukan. 22 Ne migpeuyan sikandin te me sulat diye te langun ne prubinsya ne nasakup din, sumale te kandan ne me linalahan wey pegsulat. Ka tahu te sulat, migkahi ne ka tagse lukes ne nakaasawe e, keilangan ne iyan egpangulu diye te baley rin.

21 That advice pleased the king and all the officials, and he fulfilled everything that Mamukan had said. 22 And he sent letters to all the provinces under his jurisdiction, according to their languages and their writing. The contents of the letter, said that each male who was married, it's_necessary for him to lead in his house.

Neyimu ne rayna si Istir

Istir becomes queen

21 Te ware naluhey, neulian e si Hari Aswiru ka nabelu. Nasuman-suman din e ka langun ne neyimu ni Rayna Basti, wey ka suhu ne insulat din meyitenged kandin. 2 Ne migkahiyan sikandin te me talagtambag kandin, “Mahal ne Hari, keilangan ne egpepamitew ka te me mateles ne mengebay. 3 Keilangan ne eg-alam ka te me upisyal te langun ne prubinsya ne sakup te migmanduan nu. Ne sikandan ka eg-uyan te langun ne mateles ne mengebay diye te ugpaan te me asawa te Hari kayi te Susa, ka iney ne siyudad. Iyan egpatangguwen kandan si Higay, ka kinepun ne lukes, wey keilangan ne egpeyimasaran ka me mengebay. 4 Ne ka mengebay ne igkeupii nu, iyan egkeyimu ne rayna ne igliwan ki Rayna Basti.”

21 Before long, Hari Aswiru got_over (LIT was_healed) being angry. He thought about all Queen Basti had done, and the command he had written concerning her. 2 And his advisors said to him, “Beloved King, (it is) necessary for you(sg) to search (LIT cause_to_search) for beautiful virgins. 3 It's_necessary for you(sg) to chose officials from all the provinces under the jurisdiction of your(sg) rule. And they will_bring all the beautiful virgins in the living_place of the spouses of the king here to Susa, the mother city. The one to cause_to_look_after them is Higay, the castrated male, and it's_necessary that the virgins are beautified. 4 And the virgin that you(sg) like, she will_become queen to replace Queen Basti.”

Nakapahale seeye te Hari wey intuman din ka seeye ne tambag.

This pleased the king and he obeyed that advice.

5 Ne due sabeka ne Hudiyu diye te Susa ne egngaranan ki Murdikay. Anak sikandin ni Hair, ne anak ni Simii ne anak ni Kis, ne kabuhalan ni Binhamin. 6 [xr]Matig-Hirusalim si Murdikay wey sabeka sikandin te seeye se neneuripen te Hari te Babilunya ne si Nibukadnisar. In-uyan sikandan diye te Babilunya duma ki Huwakim ne Hari te Huda te timpu ne nareeg sikandin ni Nibukadnisar. 7 Ne due atebey rin ne si Istir ne ka ngaran din te Hibruwanen si Hadasa. Amana ne mateles sikandin wey meupiya ka lawa rin. Te neilu rin e te iney wey amey, inlitan e sikandin ni Murdikay iling te malehet ne anak din.

5 There was one Hudiyu in Susa named Murdikay. He (was) an offspring of Hair, who was an offspring of Simii who was an offspring of Kis, a descendant of Binhamin. 6 [xr]Murdikay was from_Hirusalim and he was one of those who were enslaved by Nibukadnisar the king of Babilunya. They were_taken to Babilunya along_with Huwakim the king of Huda at the time that he was defeated by Nibukadnisar. 7 And there_was a female_cousin/sibling of his who was Istir and her name in Hibruwanon was Hadasa. She was very beautiful and her body was good. When she was orphaned of her mother and father, she was looked_after/adopted by Murdikay like his true child.

8 Te impatahe e ka suhu te Hari, masulug ne me mengebay ka inlibulung diye te Susa. Ne in-uyan degma si Istir diye te palasyu te Hari wey impatanggu ki Higay ka talagtanggu te me malitan. 9 Ne amana ni Higay ingkahale wey ingkeupii si Istir. Puun dutu, impeyimasaran din e si Istir wey imbehayan te meupiya ne pegkeen, wey imbehayan pad man-e te pitu ne suluhuanen ne me malitan ne in-alam din puun te palasyu te Hari. Ne diye ipeugpe ni Higay ensi Istir te amana ne meupiya ne sinabeng diye te ugpaan te me asawa te Hari. 10 Ne ware ipataha ni Istir ka tribu rin wey ke hentew ka me suled din su impanagtahaan ma sikandin ni Murdikay te kene seini igpepangguhud. 11 Ne tagse aldew, diye egbaye-baye si Murdikay te egkatangkaan te ugpaan te me asawa te Hari, eyew egkanengnengan din ke nekey e ka egkeula-ula ni Istir.

8 When the command of the king was_made known, many virgins were gathered_together in Susa. And Istir was also brought to the palace of the king and caused_to_be_looked_after by Higay the caretaker of the women. 9 And Higay was very pleased with Istir and liked her. From that, he beautified Istir and gave (her) good food, and he also gave her seven female servants that he chose from the living_place of the king. And Higay caused_ Istir(pl) _to_live in the very good room(s) in the living_place of the spouses of the king. 10 Istir didn't make her tribe known and who were her relatives because she had been_instructed by Murdikay not to tell this. 11 Every day, Murdikay would pass_by the front of the living_place of the spouses of the king, so_that (he) would know what Istir's fate was.

12 Impangusuwan ka lawa te tagse mengebay te mahal ne lana ne egngaranan te mira seled te hen-em ne bulan, wey ka seup man-e ne hen-em ne bulan, impangusuwan sikandan te me peemut. Pegkapenga te sabeka ne leg-un te peggimmimasad dan, eggingume e ka timpu ne ka tagse sabeka egpaatubangen e diye te ki Hari Aswiru. 13 Ne egtuhutan ka tagse sabeka kandan ne egsaluub ke nekey ka igkeupii rin te timpu ne eg-atubang e sikandin te Hari. 14 Ne wey e eggendiye sikandin ke egpangilumkilum e. Te pegkapawe, diye din eg-uyana te igkarangeb ne ugpaan te me asawa te Hari ne migmanduan ni Saasgas ne sabeka ne kinepun ne lukes. Ne iyan de egpakalibed diye te Hari ka seeye se igkeupii rin wey igpeumew.

12 The body of each young woman was rubbed with expensive oil named mira for (LIT inside) six months, and the next six months, they were_rubbed with perfumes. When the one year of their beautifying was_finished, the time came that each one would go_in_front of King Aswiru. 13 Then each one of them was allowed to dress in whatever she liked at the time she was to go_in_front of the king. 14 She would only go if it was getting dark. At dawn, she was_taken to the second/another living_place of the spouses of the king ruled by Saasgas a (LIT one) castrated male. And the only ones who were able_to_return to the king were those that he liked and summoned.

15 Ne miggingume e ka timpu ne iyan e eggendiye te Hari si Istir, ka anak ni Abihail ne anggam ni Murdikay ne miglitan kandin. Ware din migbuyu te minsan nekey angin e te intambag ni Higay[fn] kandin. Ingkeupii si Istir te langun ne nakakita kandin. 16 In-uyan si Istir diye te ugpaan ni Hari Aswiru te igkasapulu ne bulan ne egngaranan te Tibit, igkapitu seeye ne leg-un te pegmandu din. 17 Te pegginguma ni Istir diye, ingkeupii sikandin te Hari labew te langun ne malitan wey ingkahale din labew te langun ne mengebay. Nataman, ingkurunaan e te Hari si Istir wey miggimu rin e ne rayna liwan ki Basti. 18 Nataman, migpasahakeen e man-e ka Hari te dakel para te langun ne upisyal din wey te langun ne suluhuanen din eyew te pegpasalamat din ki Istir. Migsuhu man-e ka Hari te ware trabahu te intiru ne migmanduan din te seeye ne aldew, wey masulug pad man-e ka impandasag din.

15 The time came for Istir, the child of Abihail uncle of Murdikay who adopted her to be the one to go to the king. She didn't request anything except what Higay[fn] had recommended to her. Everyone who saw Istir liked her. 16 Istir was_taken to the living_place of King Aswiru in the tenth month called Tibit, that (being) the seventh year of his ruling. 17 At Istir's arrival there, she was desired by the king more than all the women and pleased him more than all the virgins. Afterwards, the king crowned Istir and made her queen to replace Basti. 18 Afterwards, the king again put_on_a_feast for all his officials and all his servants in_order to give_thanks for Istir. The king also commanded that there would_be_no work in his entire place_of_rule on that day, and gave many other gifts (LIT and his gifts were yet many).

Ka pegpangabangan ni Murdikay te Hari

The king is helped/rescued by Murdikay

19 Te igkarangeb e ne peglibulung te me mengebay, diye migpinnuu si Murdikay te gumawan te ugpaan te Hari.[fn] 20 Te seeye ne timpu, ware de due ipataha ni Istir ka tribu rin wey ke hentew ka me suled din su impanagtahaan ma ni Murdikay te kene egpepangguhuren. Intuman ni Istir seeye iling te pegtuman din kandin te deisek din pad.

19 At the second gathering of the virgins, Murdikay was sitting in the doorway of the living_place of the king.[fn] 20 At that time, Istir hadn't made_known her tribe and who her relatives were because Murdikay had told her not to tell_the_story. Istir obeyed/fulfilled that like she obeyed him since she was small.

21 Ne due daruwa ne kinepun ne ensi Bigatan wey si Tiris ne talagbantey te gumawan te sinabeng te Hari. Sikandan se daruwa nabelu te Hari wey migbebentaan ne eggimatayan dan sikandin. Te seeye ne timpu diye migpinpinnuu si Murdikay te gumawan te palasyu. 22 Piru nanengnengan ni Murdikay ka kandan ne pegbebentaan, wey ingguhud din seeye diye ki Rayna Istir. Ne ingguhud e degma seeye ni Istir diye te Hari wey ingguhud din degma ne si Murdikay ka migpangguhud kandin meyitenged kayi. 23 Te natahaan te Hari ne malehet ka narineg din, impabitin din e ensi Bigatan wey si Tiris. Ne puun dutu, migsuhu ka Hari ne igpasulat din seeye diye te Libru ne Sulatanan te Neneyitabu.

21 Now there were two castrated (ones) who were Bigatan and Tiris who were guards to the doorway of the bedroom of the king. Those two were angry at the king and they plotted to kill him. At that time Murdikay was sitting there at the doorway to the palace. 22 But Murdikay discovered their plan, and he told this to Queen Istir. And Istir also told it to the king and she also said that Murdikay is the (one who) had storied to her about it. 23 When the king found out that what he heard was correct, he had Bigatan and Tiris hung. And from that, the king commanded that this be written in the Book that's_a Writing_place of Things_that_happened.

Ka pegbebentaan ni Haman ne egguleen ka me Hudiyu

The plan of Haman to exterminate the Hudiyus

31 Te ware naluhey, intimulan e te Hari ka katenged ni Haman ne anak ni Hamidata ne kabuhalan ni Agag. Neyimu rin ne labew te langun ne upisyal ne duma rin. 2 Ka langun ne upisyal te Hari ne diye te gumawan te palasyu, migpanimbuel diye te ki Haman eyew te pegtahud kandin, su migsuhu ma ka Hari meyitenged kayi. Piru si Murdikay, kene mule egpanimbuel kandin. 3 Ne nataman, mig-insaan e si Murdikay te duma ne me upisyal te Hari ne diye te gumawan te palasyu ke mania te kene din egpalintutuu te suhu te Hari. 4 Ne migtabak si Murdikay, “Hudiyu a”. Ne tagse aldew, eg-insaan dan ded sikandin ke mania te kene din egpalintutuu te suhu te Hari, piru ware din sikandan sahipaa. Ne puun due, migguhuran dan e si Haman meyitenged kayi su eyew egkanengnengan dan ke egbalaharen din naan de due ka batasan din.[fn] 5 Ne migpangebel-ebel ka langet ni Haman te pegkakita rin ki Murdikay te ware migpanimbuel te pegtahud kandin. 6 Te natahaan din ne Hudiyu si Murdikay, kene din egkeupian ne si Murdikay re ka egpeyimatayan din, ke kene, migbebentaan sikandin ne egguleen egpangimatayi ka langun ne Hudiyu ne nasakup ni Hari Aswiru.

31 Before long, the king increased the responsibilities of Haman the child of Hamidata the descendant of Agag. He became above all of the other officials. 2 All of the officials of the king in the doorway of the palace, kneeled to Haman in_order to respect him, because the king commanded concerning it. But Murdikay, on_the_contrary (he) didn't kneel to him. 3 Afterwards, Murdikay was_asked by the other officials of the king who were at the doorway of the palace why he didn't believe/obey the command of the king. 4 And Murdikay answered, “I (am) a Hudiyu”. And every day, they asked him why he didn't believe/obey the command of the king, but he did not pay_attention to them. And from that, they storied to Haman about it so_that they could discover if he would just ignore his behavior.[fn] 5 And Haman was furious (LIT Haman's anger/hatred smoked) when he saw Murdikay wasn't kneeling in respect to him. 6 When he realized that Murdikay was a Hudiyu, he did not want that Murdikay would_be the only one_ he _caused_to_be_killed, but rather, he plotted to exterminate all of the Hudiyus who were under_the_jurisdiction of King Aswiru.

7 Te igkasapulu wey daruwa (12) ne leg-un te pegmandu ni Hari Aswiru, te an-anayan ne bulan ne egngaranan te Nisan, migsuhu si Haman ne eggimuwen ka pegpintut-pintut eyew egkekerew ke ken-u eggimuwa ka implanu rin, wey egngaranan te “pur” ka inggamit dan te pegpintut-pintut. Ne ka naalam, igkasapulu wey tatelu (13) ne aldew te igkasapulu wey daruwa (12) ne bulan ne egngaranan te Adar.

7 In the twelfth (12) year of the rule of King Aswiru, in the first month named Nisan, Haman commanded to make a drawing_of_lots in_order to schedule when what he planned would_be_done, and what they used for drawing_lots was called “pur”. And what was_chosen, (was) the thirteenth (13) day of the twelfth (12) month named Adar.

Ka kabantug enni Hari Aswiru wey ni Murdikay

The fame of King Aswiru and Murdikay

101 Ne migsuhu si Hari Aswiru ne keilangan ne egbayad te buhis ka langun ne sakup din, minsan ka diye te pulu te dahat. 2 Ne nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Pirsya wey Midiyan ka langun ne inggimu te Hari pinaahi te geem wey te karesen din. Nasulat man-e diye ka meyitenged te kabantug ne imbehey rin ki Murdikay. 3 Su egpakasinsinundul ka katungdanan ni Murdikay te katungdanan te Hari. Neyimu sikandin ne talahuren wey amana ne igkeupii te me karumaan din ne me Hudiyu, su migpakannekal sikandin para te keupianan te me karumaan din wey te meupiya ne peg-ugpe te langun ne keet-etawan din.

101 Then Hari Aswiru commanded that (it was) necessary that all that was under him pay tax, even those on the island of the sea. 2 And all that the king did by means of his power and strength was_written in the Writing_place of the Stories of the kings of Pisiya and Midiyan. Also written about there_is the honor that he gave to Murdikay. 3 For Murdikay's position/responsibilities were next_after the position/responsibilities of the king. He became respected and very_well liked by his relatives/people the Hudiyus, because he strove for the well-being/peace of his relatives and for a good living_situation for all of his people.
